source_text.body:
Run family and HVAC business tasks with a fleet of bots
The poster runs many Grok Bot agents that walk through a daily office list, draft replies in their voice, and keep a skimmable email feed with key details.
·
Oct 31, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The poster split work across about two dozen Grok bots, each with one job. For the business side, a Work Mail bot wakes on new email, reads and files it, saves attachments into job Dropbox folders, and routes messages to specialist bots; Abbott then walks the owner through a daily office list one tap at a time and drafts replies in the owner's voice, while an Email Log bot keeps a condensed feed of emails needing human review. The owner tunes bots in plain English and still approves anything sent to customers or vendors.
How it went
It kept the inbox near zero and condensed long documents, like a 23-page punch list, into a few actionable bullets. The poster says nothing goes out under their name without approval, so the system still depends on human signoff for external communication.
Worth knowing
On Grok Ultra, the poster said they hit about 50% usage in one week, then 60% after two days the next week.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Each morning at [time], go through my inbox for [business name] and give me a skimmable list of what needs a response, with sender, request, deadline, and dollar amount or key details for each. Draft replies in my voice using the examples in [folder or pasted samples], but do not send any of them. Show me the drafts and wait for my approval before sending.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xgrf08/i_run_about_two_dozen_ai_bots_for_my_family_and
